What if Hollow Knight was fully 3D?

Hallownest in full 3D means Deepnest is now a real spider maze you can get lost in from every angle. Pantheon of Hallownest with a lock-on camera? Absolute Radiance alone would break controllers worldwide. Would Hollow Knight be better in 3D, or does it lose its magic without the hand-drawn 2D?
